definitions.explanation: A national holiday on the second Monday of January that celebrates young people who have reached adulthood. Towns and cities hold coming-of-age ceremonies on or around the day.

examples.japanese: {成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Coming of Age Day is a national holiday.

examples.japanese: {成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振袖|ふりそで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I wore a furisode kimono on Coming of Age Day.

examples.japanese: {成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{晴|は}れ{着|ぎ}→晴れ着：12995_haregi⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: On Coming of Age Day, young people in their best clothes attend ceremonies all over the country.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Until 1999 the holiday was fixed on January 15; since 2000 it falls on the second Monday of January. The legal age of adulthood was lowered from 20 to 18 in 2022, but most towns still hold the ceremony for 20-year-olds, often renamed ⟦{二十歳|はたち}→二十歳：02933_hatachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集|つど}い→集い：14600_tsudoi⟧. Young women traditionally wear a long-sleeved ⟦{振袖|ふりそで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧ kimono; young men wear suits or hakama.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧: the coming-of-age ceremony itself
- {成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連休|れんきゅう}→連休：07587_renkyuu⟧: the three-day weekend that includes the holiday
